text:
aline: heads-up: Corvette Analytics (acct 6624) replied to our overdue note on INV-2026-031. they say the invoice includes a vendor pass-through charge they didn't authorize and asked us to pause collections while they confirm with procurement. they attached a PO reference.

lia: can you paste the disputed line? i'll lookup the vendor pass-through entries in the ledger.

aline: pasted the snippet: 

```
INV-2026-031
Date: 2026-04-12
Total: $18,430.00
1) Platform subscription: $10,000.00
2) Usage (tokens): $6,200.00
3) Third-party connectors (vendor pass-through): $2,230.00  <-- they dispute
```

collections-bot: automated: dunning notice sent to billing@corvette.ai on 2026-04-20 09:18 UTC (INV-2026-031).

derek: pulling ledger: entry shows vendor connector charge vndr_238 for 2026-03-29. looks like this was billed per our contract addendum when connectors were enabled. but the PO they pasted references an older scope that doesn't authorize connector spend.

lia: request from Corvette procurement says connector was trial, not approved org-wide. they want us to hold collections until legal reviews contract. recommend pausing dunning and flagging to AR team.

aline: agreed. pause automated reminders. collections policy: charges under $5k can be disputed and reviewed by collections manager. this is $2.23k so we can credit if at fault. but need legal confirmation before issuing credit for third-party pass-throughs.

derek: suggested path: 1) pause collections and notify sales/legal, 2) ask Corvette for any inbound evidence that connector was turned on by an authorized admin, 3) if not provided within 7 days, offer a one-time goodwill credit for vendor line and a 30-day payment plan for remaining balance.

collections-bot: automated: collections workflow paused for INV-2026-031 by collections (aline) at 2026-04-20 09:45 UTC.

lia: i've created ticket ZD-4687 and added Corvette's PO and our connector enable logs. tagging legal@ and acct-exec. please add any comms.

corvette.billing (via email paste): procurement says connector was enabled during a PI trial by an engineer but no procurement sign-off. will escalate internally; can you hold any late fees while we resolve?

aline: reply drafted: we will pause dunning and waive late fees during the review window. please provide the admin audit log for connector enablement within 7 days. if no authorization is shown, we'll offer a one-time credit for the third-party charge and propose a 30-day split plan for the remainder. cc'ing legal and your AM.

derek: legal prefers we do not pre-commit to credits until they sign off, but fine to waive late fees and pause dunning. add note: if client requests refund, route credit through AR with a signed credit approval form.

lia: added legal note to ZD-4687 and scheduled internal review for 2026-04-23. also created ENG-9122 to add connector enablement visibility to the admin audit logs (requested by legal).

collections-bot: automated: reminder set for 2026-04-27 to review ZD-4687 if client hasn't produced logs.

aline: ok team. hold status for collections: "on hold - contract dispute pending legal". if vehicle (Corvette) confirms they enabled connector via authorized admin, we will resume collection and remove hold. if not, offer goodwill credit for $2,230 and issue INV-2026-031-R1 with new balance $16,200 and a 30-day payment option.

derek: logged a follow-up: if Corvette misses payment after the hold and we don't reach resolution within 30 days, escalate to salesOps and legal for recovery.

aline: thanks all. small ops ask: include AM in all replies — don't send final credit without sales sign-off. closing notes here until ZD-4687 updates. :white_check_mark:
